q0.question: Symptom Check (Decision Tree): Choose one, or use dataset search.

q_dataset_search.question: Type your symptoms (example: 'fever and cough for 2 days', 'chest tightness', 'vomiting and diarrhea'). I will search the dataset and suggest the best path.

q1_chest_redflags.question: Is the chest pain severe OR with shortness of breath, sweating, nausea, fainting, or pain spreading to arm/jaw/back?

q_chest_duration.question: How long has it been happening?

q1_breathing_redflags.question: Is breathing difficulty severe (cannot speak full sentences), with bluish lips, confusion, or worsening rapidly?

q_breathing_with_fever.question: Do you also have fever or chest tightness?

q1_fever.question: How high is the fever (if you know)?

q_fever_redflags.question: Any of these: stiff neck, severe headache, rash, dehydration (very dry mouth/no urination), confusion, seizures, or persistent vomiting?

q_fever_duration.question: How long has the fever been present?

q1_headache_redflags.question: Is it the worst headache of your life OR with weakness/numbness, trouble speaking, vision loss, fainting, or confusion?

q_headache_duration.question: How long has it been happening?

q1_abdomen_redflags.question: Any of these: severe belly pain, blood in stool/vomit, black tarry stool, severe dehydration, or pain with fainting?

q1_injury_redflags.question: Is there heavy bleeding, deep wound, head injury with vomiting/confusion, suspected fracture, or severe pain?

q_other.question: Do you feel the problem is severe, rapidly worsening, or you feel unsafe right now?

OUT_EMERGENCY.title: Emergency
OUT_EMERGENCY.text: This could be serious. Please go to the nearest ER or call local emergency services immediately. Do not delay.

OUT_URGENT_TODAY.title: Urgent (Today)
OUT_URGENT_TODAY.text: You should seek urgent medical care today (urgent care/ER depending on severity). If symptoms worsen, treat as emergency.

OUT_APPOINTMENT_SOON.title: Appointment (Soon)
OUT_APPOINTMENT_SOON.text: Book an appointment soon (within 24–72 hours). If symptoms worsen rapidly, seek urgent care.

OUT_APPOINTMENT_ROUTINE.title: Routine Appointment
OUT_APPOINTMENT_ROUTINE.text: Book a routine appointment. Track symptoms and seek urgent care if any red flags appear.

OUT_SELFCARE_MONITOR.title: Self-care + Monitor
OUT_SELFCARE_MONITOR.text: Monitor symptoms, rest, hydrate, and consider booking if it persists or worsens. If red flags appear, seek urgent care.

OUT_GENERAL_GUIDANCE.title: General Guidance
OUT_GENERAL_GUIDANCE.text: Please describe your symptoms (what you feel, when it started, severity, fever yes/no). I can guide next steps and help you book an appointment.
